skills.name: Sylvan Breath (林间息/森の息吹)
skills.line: The breath of the forest lingers on the wind.
skills.description: SP Shishio waves a tree branch and directs a florescent light towards a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Deer Tracer (寻鹿迹/鹿の跡)
skills.line: I won't give up on my friends.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. Whenever SP Shishio attacks an enemy, he inflicts them with Sylvan Soul, lasts for 1 turn. At the start of his turn, he absorbs the Sylvan Souls from the enemies to gain an equal amount of Sylvan Hearts, lasts for 2 turns. ;Sylvan Soul (森の霊) : :'''General, Mark''': Triggers whenever the enemy launches an attack. SP Shishio drains their ATK by 20% of their initial ATK (cannot exceed more than 280% of his own initial ATK), max of 3 stacks, and decreases their move bar by 15%. At the end of their turn, removes 2 stacks of the draining effect. Each mark can trigger up to 3 times. ;Sylvan Heart (森の心) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack increases his RES by 20%.

upgrades.text: When he's inflicted with a debuff or control effect, has a 30% chance to be immune to them and gain a Sylvan Heart .
At the start of turn, each Sylvan Heart stack he has recovers his HP by 13% of his max HP.
When a Sylvan Soul is triggered, increases his SPD by 60, lasts for 1 turn.
If the enemies don't have a Sylvan Soul, and at the end of non-summoned enemies' turn, increases his move is by 10% .

skills.name: Sylvan Pact (森之契/森の契り)
skills.line: My people are still here with me.
skills.description: SP Shishio focuses the spiritual breath of his people to attack 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 228% of his ATK. If he has a Sylvan Heart, also decreases the enemy's move bar by 40%; if they are pushed to the bottom of the move bar, he has a 100% base chance to inflicting them with Vinebound, lasts for 1 turn. ;Sylvan Heart (森の心) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack increases his RES by 20%. ;Vinebound (纒繞/絡みつく) : :Bound by vines, cannot deal damaged and boost to move bar effects are decreased by 60%. Cannot be dispelled.

upgrades.text: Each Sylvan Heart he has increases this skill's damage multiplier by 25%.
When he has 1 Sylvan Heart, he attacks 1 additional enemy at random.
When he has 2 Sylvan Hearts, he attacks 2 additional enemies at random.
When he has 3 Sylvan Hearts, he's guaranteed to inflict Vinebound.

bio.condition: Donate 1 SP Shishio shard in guild.
